jobs.jobDescription: Design and implement scalable microservices using Node.js, Go, and PostgreSQL. Optimize API performance and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.
Develop end-to-end web applications utilizing Next.js, Python, and GraphQL. Participate in architecture decisions and code reviews across the entire stack.
Maintain and enhance automated CI/CD pipelines, manage Kubernetes clusters, and implement infrastructure as code using Terraform.
Create user-centered wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design systems in Figma. Conduct usability testing to refine product interfaces.
Build predictive machine learning models in Python, write complex SQL queries, and deliver data-driven insights to executive stakeholders.
Develop native iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI. Focus on offline-first caching, smooth UI animations, and App Store delivery.
Define product roadmaps, write detailed user stories, and lead cross-functional agile teams from feature inception through deployment.
Monitor security operations centers (SOC), conduct vulnerability assessments, and implement incident response strategies to protect enterprise infrastructure.
Ensure 99.99% system availability through automated monitoring, incident management, and chaos engineering practices using Prometheus and Grafana.
Train and deploy deep learning models using PyTorch and Hugging Face. Optimize LLM inference pipelines for production real-time applications.
Architect and maintain native Android apps using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Implement robust unit and UI automated test suites.
Design and execute automated testing suites for web and mobile platforms using Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium within continuous integration workflows.
